{{Quote|Sir, the prisoners did not make it to the interrogation level.''"<br />"''What...did...you...just...say!''"<br />"''Er...We think they might have got...|This droid speaking to Osi Sobeck|<ref name="Counterattack">{{TCW|Counterattack}}</ref>}}
This '''OOM security battle droid''' was stationed on the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Lola Sayu/Legends|Lola Sayu]] in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel]] [[Prison/Legends|prison]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]] at the time of the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|Battle of Lola Sayu]].

==Biography==
During the [[Battle of Lola Sayu/Legends|Battle of Lola Sayu]], this [[OOM-series security droid/Legends|OOM security battle droid]] along with many others were under command of [[Prison/Legends|prison]] [[Warden/Legends|warden]], [[Phindian/Legends|Phindian]] [[Osi Sobeck/Legends|Osi Sobeck]] in the [[Citadel/Legends|Citadel's]] [[Citadel Command/Legends|command room]] . After the elite team of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] arrived in the detention center and rescued [[Even Piell/Legends|Even Piell]] who was being held there for interrogation, they split up into two [[Squad/Legends|squads]]. The one led by Obi-Wan Kenobi was eventually captured by Sobeck and the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] that should have taken them to the interrogation level were intercepted by [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2's]] [[R2-D2's battle droid squadron/Legends|squadron]] of reprogrammed [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] which helped the [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoners]] get to the detention facility's landing bay. This [[Droid/Legends|droid]] reported the incident to Sobeck, who in turn became enraged, but their discussion was cut short by [[K2-B4/Legends|K2-B4]].

==Behind the scenes==
This droid, like every battle droid in [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars (film)|''The Clone Wars'' movie]] and [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''The Clone Wars'' TV series]], was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]]. His name was never given.
